name: url
label: Start URL
help: The site or section to crawl, such as https://example.com/docs.

name: limit
label: Page limit
help: Maximum pages to read (1–1,000). Credits for this many pages are held when the crawl starts, and the pages not read are refunded. Pricing: https://serpkite.com/pricing.

name: max_depth
label: Maximum depth
help: Link hops from the start URL.

name: include_paths
label: Include paths
help: Only crawl paths matching these patterns, such as /docs/*.

name: query
label: Query
help: Read the pages most relevant to this phrase first.

name: webhook_url
label: Webhook URL
help: Receives the result when the crawl ends, for example a Make custom webhook.
